_comment: Independent C witness for an active elven-cloak wear. Wizard.c starts this role in a cloak of magic resistance; after the debug wish, T auto-selects the only worn cloak and frees the slot. W then selects the wished cloak by its C-observed o inventory letter and reaches accessory_or_armor_on(), Cloak_on(), and toggle_stealth(). The seed, date and name are independently chosen for this source branch.
